title: Rabbi Elazar bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 47:5, but Hyman says the reading should be “R′ Berekhyah, R′ Elazar and R′ Avin in the name of Rabbi Meir,” as the statement is cited in Bereshit Rabbah 48:14.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 48:14 has Rabbi Tanchuma reporting Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Avun in Rabbi Meir’s name. This supports Meir for ר״מ but differs from Hyman’s proposed Berekhyah–Elazar–Avin wording. Hyman’s proposed parsing is preserved rather than silently harmonized to that digital text.

The consulted Midrash Rabbah — TE text of Shemot Rabbah 47:5 has Rabbi Tanchuma reporting Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Avin in Rabbi Meir’s name, supporting the full heading locally. Bereshit Rabbah 48:14 instead has Rabbi Tanchuma reporting Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Avun in Rabbi Meir’s name. Hyman’s proposed Berekhyah–Elazar–Avin chain retains R′ for its abbreviated personal titles; the shared full Rabbi Meir supports that expansion of ר״מ. The different chains are retained without adopting Hyman’s emendation or identifying their parties.
